result.summary: The page renders largely as expected; excluded carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff are not treated as defects. One minor content oddity is visible: a “-0%” badge on the lower popular card.

issues.description: A promotional badge on the partially visible lower card reads “-0%”, which is confusing/nonsensical as a discount value.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge when there is no discount, or display a valid value such as “0% delivery”, “Free delivery”, or the actual percentage.
